patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks with large, immersive imagery or video on one side and concise text on the other, often spanning the full viewport width.
A clear typographic hierarchy uses a large, bold sans-serif for primary headings, a lighter sans-serif for body text, and a distinct monospace font for labels, navigation, and secondary information.
A sophisticated palette built around a warm, light neutral background, deep black text, and a distinctive muted plum accent color for interactive elements and overlays.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, while the hero text maintains a gentle parallax effect over the background video.
Feature sections are introduced with a large, descriptive heading followed by a brief paragraph and a 'read more' call-to-action, often paired with a striking visual.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video that plays on loop, with a large, prominent text overlay that subtly parallaxes against the video as the user scrolls. An initial promotional modal appears on page load, which can be dismissed.
A minimalist header bar appears and sticks to the top of the viewport after an initial scroll, providing persistent navigation and a call-to-action.
Content sections are animated using CSS keyframes to fade in and slide up slightly from the bottom as they become visible within the user's viewport, creating a dynamic reveal effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by a legible sans-serif body and small, uppercase monospace labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements featuring crisp 90-degree corners, though some buttons and input fields have a very subtle, almost imperceptible rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and allowing imagery to breathe.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated, editorial aesthetic achieved through the combination of a muted plum accent color, a distinctive monospace font for UI elements, and large, artfully composed photography and video. The subtle parallax and scroll-triggered reveals add a layer of understated dynamism.
